name: SRATH
tagline: Independent projects by Tommy Jonas Rath
description: SRATH is the Danish sole proprietorship of Tommy Jonas Rath: the home of the upcoming Baiganyo webshop and independently developed Android apps.
about:
SRATH is a sole proprietorship registered in Denmark, owned and run by Tommy Jonas Rath.

Tommy works full time as a software developer. SRATH is where our own projects live: the upcoming webshop Baiganyo, and Android apps we build in our spare time because we enjoy it.
